messages:
jordan: FYI I opened a PR to rework the pricing/quotas section into a tier matrix and add fresh SDK snippets (JS + Go) plus a tiny CSV import example. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/999

tanya: Nice. Can we include a clear multi-tenant example mapping org headers to quota tiers? Customers keep asking whether to use `X-Org-Quota` or the canonical header.

kevin: Also call out that embeddings are metered differently (per-embedding vector units) vs text (per-token). Add a short table line so people dont confuse unit types.

nora: Heads upthe billing dashboard legend had a label change last week: "rate cap" -> "rate limit" and the burst credit line moved panels. We'll need to update the grafana panel refs in the docs.

jordan: Plan: (1) add a CSV example for pricing matrix import, (2) add JS backoff snippet for 429 with Retry-After, (3) Go example showing headers at call-level, (4) a one-paragraph note about embeddings vs tokens. I'll leave the grafana panel rename for a small follow-up PR to keep this focused.

tanya: For the multi-tenant snippet, something like:

```js
// client-level header
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ headers: { 'x-redwood-quota': 'tier-pro' } })
await client.usage.list({ limit: 10 })

// per-call override
await client.usage.list({ limit: 10 }, { headers: { 'x-org-quota': 'partner-B' } })
```

That shows both patterns.

kevin: Add this short note for embeddings: "Embedding calls are billed per-vector unit (embedding unit) and may not map 1:1 to token units used by text generation. Use the billing examples table to estimate cost conversions."

nora: Small nit: label the code fences with language for better rendering. Also flag l10n: the pricing matrix column headings changed so translations will need updating.

jordan: Added Go snippet too:

```go
// per-call header
client := redwood.NewClient()
resp, _ := client.Usage.List(context.Background(), &redwood.ListOptions{Limit: 5}, redwood.Headers{"x-redwood-quota": "tier-pro"})
fmt.Println(resp)
```

And the CSV import example:

```
id,name,monthly_limit,unit_type
tier-pro,Pro,100000,tokens
tier-emb,S2,20000,embeddings
```

docs-bot: link check queued for branch. Results -> 1 failing grafana URL (panel moved). CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/links/3344

tanya: LGTM aside from grafana refs and l10n. Approve and merge after a follow-up fixes the dashboard links.

kevin: Agree. The new snippets should live in the migration guide too so support can point customers to a single page.

jordan: Pushed updates: CSV example, embeddings note, JS + Go snippets, and the 429 backoff example. Filing a tiny follow-up PR for grafana panel updates and l10n strings. Will re-run link checks on that one.

nora: Thanks! Once grafana PR lands let's trigger the site build and a quick manual check of the rendered tables.

jordan: Thanks team. Targeting merge EOD if the follow-up is green. :thumbsup:
